{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Congress should consider a regulatory budget that would cap the costs federal agencies could impose on the economy in any given year.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Cronyism is inherent in the progressive vision of the administrative state.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"When government uses taxpayer funding and resources to give special advantages to private companies, it distorts the free market and erodes public trust in the political system.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Enlarging the scope of government and placing enormous power in the hands of bureaucrats multiplies opportunities for corruption and favoritism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Cronyism is the enemy of reform in education, the workplace, and healthcare.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Crony capitalism gives financial regulation that protects the large at the cost of the small.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current healthcare law is packed with corporate welfare.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Crony capitalism gives special interest tax breaks, custom-designed regulations, and special exemptions for favored parties.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Solyndra debacle is an example of crony capitalism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Crony capitalism creates both subsidies and restrictions to tilt the market one way or the other.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Crony capitalism puts the weight of government behind the status quo, leading to economic stagnation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republican Members of Congress have taken the lead in fighting crony capitalism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for others to rally to the cause of fighting crony capitalism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
